notice_boards.description:
Confidence built through service

Since 2016, Ignite has connected inclusive education with healthcare, blood-donation support, livelihoods, youth workshops, hygiene, sanitation, and social-awareness initiatives.

The story highlights how volunteers and community partners turn practical local action into confidence, opportunity, and lasting public service.
notice_boards.sub_title: A look at how education, health, livelihoods, and youth leadership grow stronger together.
notice_boards.title: Igniting Confidence Across Communities

notice_boards.description:
From one response to a long-term commitment

A winter support effort inspired a small school that opened in March 2016 with 20 learners. The work grew around a belief that poverty should never decide whether a child can learn.

Volunteers, campus representatives, blood-donation campaigns, district networks, and plans for accessible online learning now carry that commitment forward.
notice_boards.sub_title: How a winter-clothing effort grew into a school and a wider volunteer movement.
notice_boards.title: Igniting Futures Through Education

notice_boards.description:
KIDOVATION

KIDOVATION gives primary and secondary students a welcoming place to imagine, experiment, present ideas, and celebrate the power of science and technology.
notice_boards.sub_title: Young innovators explore creativity, curiosity, science, and real-world problem solving.
notice_boards.title: KIDOVATION

notice_boards.description:
Learning made possible together

What began with children asking for a chance to study grew into an inclusive school supporting around 120 learners. A network of more than 23,000 volunteers and 85 university ambassadors has helped extend education, blood donation, food support, empowerment, and housing assistance.

Their shared work shows what becomes possible when young people place service in the hands of a community.
notice_boards.sub_title: Children, volunteers, and supporters creating a more inclusive path to education.
notice_boards.title: Light in Their Hands

notice_boards.description:
Together for Their Tomorrow

This community fundraising event brings supporters and partners together around practical ways to expand education, nutrition, and essential care for children.
notice_boards.sub_title: A charity gathering bringing supporters together to raise funds for education, nutrition, and essential care.
notice_boards.title: Together for Their Tomorrow

notice_boards.description:
Volunteer Orientation Program

The orientation equips new volunteers with the knowledge, practical expectations, communication habits, and confidence needed to contribute meaningfully.
notice_boards.sub_title: New volunteers learn about Ignite’s mission, responsibilities, teamwork, and pathways for growth.
notice_boards.title: Volunteer Orientation Program

Ignite began because children showed us exactly what opportunity meant to them. Our role has always been to stand beside people, respect their leadership, and turn shared concern into practical, accountable action.<\/p>

pages.description:
A more equitable and compassionate society

Ignite envisions a future where every person can learn, grow, and shape a dignified life.

What that future looks like

Children can access inclusive education, families can strengthen their health and livelihoods, and young people can lead practical change. Resilient communities have the confidence, opportunity, and support to shape their own futures.
pages.meta_description: A more equitable and compassionate society where every person can thrive.
pages.name: Our vision
pages.sub_title: A more equitable and compassionate society where every person can thrive.

pages.description:
Information we collect

Ignite Global Foundation collects the information you choose to provide when you contact us, donate, register to volunteer, subscribe for updates, or request sponsorship information.

How information is used

We use this information to respond to you, administer the service you requested, maintain required financial and safeguarding records, and improve our programs. Card details are handled by the payment provider and are not stored on this website.

Your choices

You may ask to access, correct, or delete eligible personal information by contacting info@ignite.org.bd. We restrict access to authorized personnel and retain information only for operational, legal, and safeguarding needs.
pages.meta_description: Ignite Global Foundation privacy policy.
pages.name: Privacy policy

pages.description:
Our commitment

Ignite Global Foundation is committed to protecting children, adults at risk, community members, volunteers, and staff from abuse, exploitation, harassment, and neglect.

How we work

People representing Ignite are expected to follow safeguarding standards, treat every person with dignity, minimize risk, and report concerns promptly. Concerns are handled confidentially and shared only with people responsible for responding safely.

Report a concern

To raise a safeguarding concern, contact info@ignite.org.bd or +880 1972016221. If someone is in immediate danger, contact the appropriate local emergency or protection service first. Retaliation against a person who reports a concern in good faith is not accepted.
pages.meta_description: Ignite Global Foundation safeguarding.
pages.name: Safeguarding

pages.description:
Refund requests

For refunds, contact info@ignite.org.bd within 7 days of making the payment. Once a refund is initiated, it will be adjusted to the customer’s account within 7 working days.

Chargebacks

For a chargeback, contact the issuer bank of the card used to complete the payment. Once the bank issues the chargeback request, the requested amount will be disbursed within 14 working days.
pages.meta_description: How to request a payment refund or chargeback.
pages.name: Refunds policy
pages.sub_title: How to request a payment refund or chargeback.

pages.description:
Turn compassion into practical opportunity

Ignite Global Foundation mobilizes volunteers and works alongside communities to expand inclusive education, youth development, women’s empowerment, healthcare, livelihoods, safe water, food security, and humanitarian support.

How we work

We listen first, respect community leadership, and connect responsible support with practical action. Programs are designed around dignity, accountability, and outcomes that communities can sustain.
pages.meta_description: Turning compassion into practical opportunity alongside communities.
pages.name: Our mission
pages.sub_title: Turning compassion into practical opportunity alongside communities.

pages.description:
Using this website

You may use this website for lawful, personal purposes. Do not attempt to disrupt the service, access another person's account, upload harmful material, or misuse Ignite Global Foundation content.

Information and donations

Program information is provided for general awareness and may change as community needs evolve. Donations are processed by an independent payment provider. Contact info@ignite.org.bd promptly if you believe a transaction was made in error.

Content

Unless otherwise stated, website text, photographs, and visual materials belong to Ignite Global Foundation or are used with permission. Please request written permission before reproducing them.

pages.description:
Education that includes every learner

Ignite Global Foundation supports inclusive learning spaces, educational materials, nutritious meals, healthcare support, and life-skills development for children from marginalized communities, including children with additional needs.

What the program provides

Children receive learning resources, school support, opportunities for creativity and play, and a safe environment designed around dignity and belonging.

pages.description:
Standing with communities before and after crisis

The Disaster Response and Resilience program combines preparedness, rapid response, safe water and sanitation, health support, housing recovery, and community-led risk reduction.

Rebuilding stronger

Ignite works with local volunteers and partners so that emergency assistance protects dignity while recovery investments help families prepare for future hazards.

pages.description:
A path from vulnerability to self-reliance

Project Shabolombi works with families earning below BDT 7,000 per month. Participants receive livelihood training, productive assets, and eligible Zakat assistance shaped around a realistic household business plan.

So far, 158 families have started income-generating activities through the project.
pages.meta_description: Training and productive assets that help low-income families build sustainable livelihoods.
pages.name: Project Shabolombi
pages.sub_title: Training and productive assets that help low-income families build sustainable livelihoods.

pages.description:
Community care and prevention

A team of 12 volunteer doctors supports health screenings, checkups, medicine, and practical health education. Weekly care at Ignite School helps children receive timely attention while outreach takes services to communities with limited access.

More than 4,500 people have been reached through the program.
pages.meta_description: Preventive care, health education, medicine, and referrals closer to underserved communities.
pages.name: Project Niramoy
pages.sub_title: Preventive care, health education, medicine, and referrals closer to underserved communities.

pages.description:
Food support when it matters most

Project ONNO has reached more than 44,000 families through emergency food packs, cooked meals, Ramadan support, and school nutrition. During the COVID-19 emergency, approximately 2,500 food packs helped families through sudden income loss.

The program connects immediate relief with the dignity, health, and stability families need to recover.
pages.meta_description: Food security and emergency meals for families facing hardship.
pages.name: Project ONNO
pages.sub_title: Food security and emergency meals for families facing hardship.

pages.description:
Health information with practical support

Project Prerona combined menstrual-health education with distribution of 750 reusable sanitary-pad packs to 750 marginalized women and girls in Baunia and Uttara. The project promoted dignity, safer health practices, and progress toward gender equality.
pages.meta_description: Menstrual health, dignity, and reusable products for marginalized women and girls.
pages.name: Project Prerona
pages.sub_title: Menstrual health, dignity, and reusable products for marginalized women and girls.

pages.description:
Resilient agriculture, rooted locally

Project ANKUR began in Ishapasha, Tangail with eight families receiving hands-on training, inputs, and 15 grow bags each for climate-resilient ginger production.

From skills to market

The project combines practical capacity building, inclusive participation, production support, and market connections so small farmers can turn a manageable crop into a lasting source of income.
pages.meta_description: Climate-resilient ginger farming that helps vulnerable rural families grow dependable income.
pages.name: Project ANKUR
pages.sub_title: Climate-resilient ginger farming that helps vulnerable rural families grow dependable income.

pages.description:
Safe water closer to home

Project Tripty installed deep tube wells and supported practical water purification in places where safe drinking water was difficult to reach. The completed project improved access for more than 150,000 people across rural and disaster-prone communities.
pages.meta_description: Deep tube wells and water purification support for rural and disaster-prone communities.
pages.name: Project Tripty
pages.sub_title: Deep tube wells and water purification support for rural and disaster-prone communities.

pages.description:
Small hives, growing opportunity

Fifteen rural households received training and beekeeping support, growing from three to four hives each and managing 60 hives together.

Early harvests produced 104 kilograms of honey, followed by 120 kilograms, creating new earning opportunities for women, small farmers, and young people while supporting local biodiversity.
pages.meta_description: Sustainable beekeeping for rural households in Sirajganj.
pages.name: Project Honey
pages.sub_title: Sustainable beekeeping for rural households in Sirajganj.

pages.description:
Partner with Ignite School to shape bright futures

Ignite School began in 2016 with 35 children and now supports nearly 120 learners at its Bawnia campus, including children with additional needs.

Students receive free education from Playgroup through Class Five together with learning materials, uniforms, nutritious meals, healthcare support, creative activities, and practical life skills.
pages.meta_description: Education for all—free, inclusive learning that helps children build brighter futures.
